Copies of files from Anthropic's `anthropics/claude-plugins-official` marketplace (Apache-2.0,
`LICENSE` here and in each plugin directory), snapshot of 2026-10-10:

- `agents/code-reviewer.md`, `agents/silent-failure-hunter.md`: `plugins/pr-review-toolkit/agents/`
- `agents/math-proof-worker.md`: `plugins/math-proof/agents/`
- `commands/commit.md`: `plugins/commit-commands/commands/`
- `commands/modernize-assess.md`: `plugins/code-modernization/commands/`
- `skills/access/SKILL.md`: `external_plugins/discord/skills/access/`
- `plugins/example-plugin`, `plugins/feature-dev`, `plugins/ralph-loop`: `plugins/` (ralph-loop without its scripts)

Used unchanged as test input for Claude Code format compatibility. `../marlowe/` is Marlowe's own.
